batting.name: Mohammad Hafeez
batting.dismissal: c SA Asnodkar b MM Patel

batting.name: SC Ganguly
batting.dismissal: c M Kaif b SK Trivedi

batting.name: LR Shukla
batting.dismissal: c SA Asnodkar b Sohail Tanvir

batting.name: Umar Gul
batting.dismissal: c M Kaif b Sohail Tanvir

batting.name: GC Smith
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b Umar Gul

batting.name: SA Asnodkar
batting.dismissal: c WP Saha b I Sharma

batting.name: Sohail Tanvir
batting.dismissal: c Salman Butt b Umar Gul

balls.text: another quick yorker, outside off, drives it to long-off and completes a quick two
speedy yorker on leg stump there, that's a fine ball at the death, round-arm action that time, 131kph, digs it out to cover, not much you can do with that
slower one again, tries to scoop it over midwicket but he's deceived by it, ballooned in the air but lands short of midwicket, they hurry a couple
holds it back a bit, tucks him for room, Gul swings hard again but a thick top-edge flies straight to Kaif at long-on, that's as easy as it gets for him, third wicket for Tanvir
that's clobbered way over midwicket for six, that's a quick and full one, Gul stands up tall and swings clean, what a hit, some Pakistani love here
round the wicket and the most tantalising slower ball of the night, 99kph and Gul has no clue of when that's going to reach him, loops to the keeper
driven back down the ground, good stop from Watson, they think of a run but the bowler is quick to throw it back
blitzer! short of a length and Saha has pumelled that crisply over square leg for six, that's off the sweet spot of the bat and soars away, why is Watson bowling so short?
short one again, tapped off the back foot to the off side

short and pulled away from outside off, now then, this could be a run-out, they think of the second but Agarkar is short here, super flat throw from Ravindra Jadeja and the keeper whips the bails off quickly, that's sloppy from Agarkar - he's looking at the ball as he's going back and dives from far outside the crease. He's well short there.
135.2, short this time and Agarkar is cramped for room, no space to free his arms at all, nudged to third man
smashing start, backs off and pulps it down the ground, past mid-on for four, screams away to the fence
caught! Tanvir offers Shukla a knee-high full toss, that's a terrible ball but Shukla mis-hits the pull straight to Asnodkar at deep backward square leg, he takes the catch easily
Shukla gets inside the line by moving across his stumps and paddles the ball from outside off stump past the fielder at short fine leg, clever shot
played towards cover point off the front foot

well he's got Das with an outstanding yorker, Tanvir comes round the wicket and whips the yorker in with a quick-arm action, he swings the yorker into middle and leg and Das is late in bringing his bat down, Tanvir's celebration is unusually animated, relieved after the drop catch no doubt
played towards point once again
pushed off the front foot towards point for one more
nudged off the back foot towards midwicket for a single

shocking drop, Das backs away and lofts a short of a length ball over cover, he's hit it straight to Tanvir on the boundary who attempts the catch rather casually and drops it, Watson is gutted, he had begun to celebrate before the catch was taken, Tanvir was taking a few steps back and was in an uncomfortable position when the ball got to him

well two third men and Das still gets a four in that region, Das steps out of his crease and Watson bowls a full ball outside off stump, Das throws his bat out at it and edges the ball past the keeper with the toe end of his bat
another short ball gets big on Shukla who pulls and gets a top edge behind square, they run a single towards long leg
Das tries to pull a short ball that hurries on to him, he gets cramped for room and top edges towards midwicket
tight line and length on off stump, pushed off the front foot towards the off side
another attempted yorker and Shukla flicks the full toss through midwicket, Munaf ends an outstanding spell, 2 for 22 off four overs
full ball in the blockhole outside off stump, Shukla tries to hit through the off side but gets beaten
lovely ball, Munaf pitches on a good length and seams the ball away from Shukla who tries to open the face of the bat but gets beaten
full and wide outside off stump, Das reaches out for it and drives the ball hard through cover point, he overbalanced as he played the shot
a good length ball swings into the right-hander, Shukla moves across and nudges the ball towards midwicket for  a single
the attempted yorker ends up as a low full toss outside off, driven off the front foot through cover point
Shukla begind off in fourth gear! He moves towards the off side, swivels and pulls a short ball over the fine leg boundary, smashing start
fuller ball on middle and leg, nudged off the pads towards midwicket

all over for Dada, scooped straight down the throat of long-on, that's a quick one outside off, Ganguly backs away but settles for a strange scoop towards long-on, straight to Kaif and Eden is silenced
slower one again, tucked to the on side, he's mixing it up wonderfully
126kph this time, he's varying it well, angled to short third man, both the third man and fine leg are up, he needs to be accurate here
slower one again, Trivedi is a slower bowler, guys, let's face it, glided away to third man
backs away again, scooped to long-on but only a single
crisply smashed to midwicket but only a single, he's hitting them clean here
round the wicket, dropped it a bit short but saw him giving himself room, tapped to the off side, bottom edge there
103.5kph, full and on middle and leg, tapped away through midwicket
that's tonked, short and outside off, Debabrata stands and pulls that with fury, way, way over the midwicket stands for six, that's gone 81 metres, they're planning a party in Siliguri
quicker one outside off, tries to angle past third man but it's a fine bit of fielding by Munaf, keeps them to a single
down the track and tries to loft the sweep again, but it's slower and he only gets a bottom edge to short fine leg for a single
tossed up on off but he's quick on the sweep and picks off a single behind square
73.7, juicy legbreak there, Debabrata is fooled there, welcome to the world, young man, flighted and he's beaten
flipper here, cramped for room but he stands back and manages to tuck it away to the on side for a couple

ladies and gentlemen, introducing Debabrata, down the track and swings clean, what a shot, whistles towards the sight-screen for a biggie, Shane is a bit stunned, Eden is abuzz, that's as smooth a straight hit as you will see tonight.
slow legbreak this time, watchfully defended
97.2kph, fired in on middle and leg, turned away for a single

got 'em! quick offbreak that's crashed into middle stump, Hussey jumps down the ground and swings across the line but Yusuf has fired that offbreak in fast, it's gone through the big gap between bat and pad and rattled middle stump. Yusuf is ecstatic
97.6kph, short of a length, gives himself room but can only manage a bottom edge, straight to the fielder
tapped to the off side, quick run too, quickish from Yusuf
slightly short again, Hussey dances down the track and swings to midwicket, fine fielding from Tanvir there, keeps them down to one, that was a fine throw too
short of a length, tapped to the on side but fine diving safe from Asnodkar
79.4kph, ripper from off to middle, Ganguly thinks of jumping out, thinks of giving himself room, thinks of getting a run but it's a dot, cramped for room and can't do much
full toss on leg stump and Ganguly misses out, sweeps straight to square leg, that was a gimme
Hussey jumps out of the crease, Warne drops is slightly short, he needs to adjust his shot and cut to cover, good battle here
turned to the on side, that was a legbreak which turned a bit more

huge, Ganguly says enough is enough, down the ground and an emphatic sweep that's lofted over square leg, it's flatter but he can murder spinners, way over the ropes for a biggie, the first six of the day
legbreak that's on off, turns into the left-hander, Ganguly backs away and flays it hard towards extra cover, they pick up a couple
another slower one, this time fuller, Ganguly reaches out for it and pushes to mid-off
114.1, another slower one, and he's classed as a medium-pacer, hardly bowled two quick ones in a row, short of a length and Ganguly tries to steer down to third man, misses it
127.7kph, low full toss, Hussey missed out there, might have wanted to smash it out of the ground, pushed to mid-off
down the leg side this time, Trivedi is having a poor over here, helped along past the keeper for four, two rank balls here
too short and too wide, Hussey simply waits and steers it to third man for four, the square-ish fielder has no chance
another slower one from Sid (as Warne has nicknamed him), driven watchfully to mid-on
another leggie, Hussey on the front foot but drives straight to short extra cover, super start from Shaney (as Younis Khan just referred to him)
on the front foot and driven wide of the bowler, but Warne is there quick, fielding it sharp and ready to throw it back
77.9kph, legbreak that pitches on middle, Hussey goes back and pushes watchfully
tossed up, outside off, tapped carefully to the on side for a quick single
worked away to the on side, padded away
wide one, legbreak but not turning that much, Hussey tries to cut but can't gauge the slightly low bounce

slightly short this time, and angling away, Ganguly walks down and flays it wildly, get his timing going this time and that's beaten third man, good bit of innovation there, it's time they got a move on
107.5kph, slower one again, this time full, Trivedi is on a roll here, Ganguly pushes back to the bowler, not able to get any timing going
another slower one, not coming onto the bat, Ganguly needs to wait an age for it and can't work it away, dribbles to slip
walks down the ground and looks to loft over the in field, bottom edge trickles to midwicket and they pick up two
114kph, short bouncer there, Ganguly misreads that, tries to flay through the covers but can only manage an inside edge to the off side
short of a length, angling away from the left-hander, cuts but is done in by extra bounce
left alone outside off, moving a shade away, successful over again
129kph, good-length outside off, pushed tentatively to short extra-cover

got 'em! Munaf strikes back, fuller length this time and it's on middle and leg, that came back a bit after pitching, Butt tries to push tentatively but is rapped on the pads, huge appeal and that's given, height was an issue but the umpire thought it's striking the stumps

that's the shot of the evening, gives himself room, sees the ball thrown up little wide but he's flayed that through the covers on one knee, classical mixes with improvisation there, Eden is alive and well
low full toss there, outside off but he's used his wrists superbly, spanked it through midwicket for four, he's too classy with these
Super start, short of a length, moving away, Butt tries to jab but he's beaten by the movement
and Ganguly's taken the mickey out of him, backs away and angles the bat past short third man for four, that was classic Ganguly, trying his best to outwit the opposition captain
135.1, fine change of pace, pushed to the on side, only one again
119.4kph, slow bouncer here, Ganguly backs away and tries to flash but struggles with the timing again, tapped to cover
backs away, tries to lash it through the off side but can't beat the fielder, they hurry a single, this is tight bowling here
short one, he dug it in hard, that was pacy too, tries to pull and manages only a bottom edge to short midwicket
right on the ball, short of a length, tapped to the off side, they rush for a single
walks down the track again, Ganguly doesn't have much of a clue but is trying to clear the field, thick inside edge goes to square leg, even Dada is smiling by the end of it
signs of frustration here, Ganguly backs off and tries to whack that over mid-on but can't get the timing right, dribbled to mid-on
short of a length, on middle and leg, tapped away to fine leg, sensible
little walk down the track again, Munaf sees him coming and hits it short and wide but Butt out-thinks him, nudges it past the first slip for four, he knew exactly what he was doing there, fine shot
he's taken a little step in front and slapped that hard through the covers, on the up and that's class, he finds the placement and gets Eden to its feet, they need a move on here
full and on off, good pace there, driven back to the bowler
down the leg side, worked away to fine leg for another single, tight stuff from Rajasthan, Eden getting restless
shorter one this time, Ganguly isn't quick enough onto it but manages a tame pull to fine leg, loops up but short of the fielder, just one
superb slower ball here, surprises Ganguly and he can only push it tentatively to cover, the crowd are getting into this now, boos go around
back of a length this time, no chance for Ganguly to get that away, he's on the money here alright, good change of ends here
jags back into the left hander, surprises him and he has no stroke for that, they think of a quick run but decide against it
good line this, doesn't allow him a chance to free his arms, tapped to cover
similar ball again, driven straight to mid-off again, tight over this, just five off it
tapped to cover
straight and on the money here, short of a length, the kind you want from your premier bowler, defended watchfully to mid-off
drifting down the leg side now, that's wide in this format, Butt tries to flick but can't make contact
straighter this time, short of a length, tries to cut but can't get the timing, trickles to cover
short and wide, slapped away superbly past point, he times it really well, the modern Saeed Anwar they call him, Watson not getting his line right yet
full and outside off, driven hard but straight to cover, that was in the slot but Butt can't get it away
fine over this, wicket maiden that, tapped to the off side, super stuff from Munaf
short of a length, cramped for room, outside off and jabbed to point, five dots in  row

he's got his man this time, good-length ball that was moving slightly away, Hafeez felt it was in the slot and tried to loft it over the infield but he's not got the timing right, that hits the inside half of the bat and pops straight to Asnodkar at mid-on. He appeared to be sent in to go after the bowling but has to go now.
short of a length again, cramps him for room, tapped to the off side, three dots in a row

dropped, Hafeez walks down the track and slaps a short one back to Munaf but he didn't seem to expect it and was slow to get his hands around it, strikes him on the shoulder and has the bowler gasping
appeal straight away, angling in from off to leg, rapped on the pads but that was sliding down leg, they think of a quick run but decide against it
good one to end the over, full and on off, making him search for that, turned to the leg side but straight to the fielder, that's the right length to hit
on middle and leg again, he hasn't got the line going here, turned away but they decide against the single
on the pads again, tries to turn it but is struck on the pads, deflected away for a leg bye
fine ball there, angled across the right-hander, he looks for a loose drive but is beaten all ends up, that had him napping
on the pads again, he's over the wicket and straying too much, tucked away towards short midwicket
on the pads, launched into the leg side, that's in the air but Trivedi, coming around from fine leg, can't get to it, the outfield seems slippery and he lets it go for a boundary
down the leg side, starts with a wide, it's Pakistan v Pakistan first up, two slips in place and there seems to be a bit of swing around

what a way to finish! Yusuf has done it in style, chips it way over square leg for a big six, he's turned this match around in a trice and stands at the non-striker's end and flexes his muscles at his team-mates. They've plucked the chestnuts out of the fire here. In the semi-finals for sure now, Rajasthan. And they truly deserve to be the first team to do so.
ripper, round the wicket and short again, he stands and pulls with serious power, steaming through midwicket for four, what a tournament he's having
another one, short again and down leg, Gul is probably trying too hard to bounce him here, Yusuf waits and watches
short and wide outside leg, Yusuf doesn't need to touch that (though he tries to pull), wide called
backs away and inside out loft over extra cover for four, Yusuf can't do anything wrong tonight, bounces at extra cover and goes for four

rocks back and pushes through covers, and they've scampered two again, how can Kolkata allow that, the fielder is slow and the throw isn't too straight, Kaif is speeding as if it's his last game, Rajasthan are taking the mickey out of Kolkata here, Eden has been silenced
short one this time, he comes down the track but can only pat it tamely to point
attempted yorker turns into a yorker, Yusuf pushes that to mid-off and takes off but Debabrata doesn't even take a shot at the stumps, Ishant is furious, Kolkata's fielding has fallen to pieces here
short of a length, angling in from off to middle, flicked away off his hips for a single
shimmies down the track and lofts to extra cover, it falls short of the fielder and they hurry through for a couple
tapped to point
jumps down the track again, slapped away down the ground but the long-on is back now, retains strike
pulls away a short one to midwicket, not that well timed but he picks up two, this is a walk in the park now
short of a length, beaten this time, tries to angle it down to third man but misses it
Kaif on a roll now, charges out and that's driven hard down the ground for another, the field is in and he's making most of it, hat-trick of fours, it's all too easy now
down the track again, smashed a full one past point for another four, he's in a hurry now, Kaif is turning it on now
down the track and he's squeezed that through covers for four, it was uppish but the short extra cover couldn't latch on to it despite the dive, the mid-off is in and that's running away

another missed chance, Kolkata aren't fielding anywhere near their best here, tapped to point and Butt misses another direct hit, Kaif would have been out of the crease again, these two batsmen are being reckless with their running and Kolkata are not capitalising
127.2kph, full and straight, pushed back to the bowler
he's tired after all those twos, drives half-heartedly to midwicket for a single
and another, pulled behind square and another couple, this is serious pressure on the fielding side, Yusuf is unstoppable now
full toss, turned to square leg and another couple, Butt doesn't have a strong arm and they exploit that
turned behind square and they rush back for a couple, that was a dangerous second but the throw is awry and Yusuf gets there without much of a problem
short again, tries to pull it away over square leg but can't get the timing right, pops up over the infield and he will retain the strike
130kph, driven to cover, diving stop that keeps them down
short one and tries to pull but can't get his timing right, goes to square leg
lady luck is on Yusuf's side here, another full one and his attempted heave ends in an inside edge past fine leg for four, whatever he touches is turning to gold

what a chance! driven to cover and Yusuf has backed up too far, he is mid-way down the pitch and Kaif needs to go for it, the fielder at cover misses the direct hit, he could have lobbed it back to the bowler and Yusuf might have still been out, things not going Kolkata's way at the moment
patted off the back foot to cover

that's another monster! this is an array of strokeplay straight out of the Caribbean manual, stand and deliver stuff, waits for a good-length ball and thunders it between square leg and midwicket for another massive six, he's on roller-skates here
that's huge! it's in the slot and Yusuf has waited for that and pulverised that, it's way, way over midwicket for a biggie, what a sensational hit, he's one of the hardest hitters of the cricket ball
straight and moving in, he tries to paddle it past short fine leg but is struck n the pads, big appeal but there seemed to be an inside edge, not given
turned away from outside off to midwicket, they think of two but 'No' is the loud call, Yusuf is a hare between the stumps too
he's lofted that smartly, Kaif gets that in the slot and chips it over mid-off for four, surprises Ganguly with that
112kph, in the corridor outside off, driven to cover, can't find the gap
pushed off the back foot to cover

huge appeal, swinging yorker and this time it's accurate, no chance for the batsman, rapped on the pads and Gul lets out a huge appeal, that was missing the second set of stumps too, no way he was giving that
fortune favours Yusuf, he tries to loft it over midwicket but an inside edge runs away past the keeper for four, streaky but that will work

attempted swinging yorker but turns into a full toss, Yusuf has caressed that sweetly through midwicket for four, he's can be a danger man as well, this Rajasthan team keep throwing these surprises at you
walks down the ground, it's slightly short and he's pushed wide of mid-on, good stop that keeps them down to one
full and swinging a bit, tapped to cover, the fielders are alert here
tight line and length on off stump, Pathan defends on the front foot towards cover

bowled him! Look at Ganguly run in celebration! He's sprinting and his team-mates are charging to mob him! The length is good just outside off stump,  Watson comes forward and tries to hit across the line towards the leg side, the ball nips into the right-hander and crashes into off stump after Watson misses
he moves forward this time and flicks the ball with lovely use of his wrists towards deep backward square leg
deft touch, Watson stays in his crease, waits for the ball to angle into him and opens the face at the very last moment to play the ball fine towards third man
good length ball just outside off stump, Watson stays on the back foot and pushes towards cover
Kaif stays in his crease and drives the ball behind point to third man
smashed away through midwicket, not neatly timed but that's racing away to the fence for four, what a shot

full and swinging, rapped on the pads and there's a huge appeal, not given, there's some hesitation there and Debabrata Das has made a fool of himself, he tries to do a Jonty Rhodes by running all the way to the stumps but Watson makes it comfortably, he should have got rid of that ball much earlier

what a shot that is! he was waiting for that, short of a length and on the pads again, swivels into that one, and rips it way over square leg for six, that pick-up shot again, he's one heck of a batsman
that's just not on, on the pads and that could have soared over square leg, padded away for two leg-byes
short of a length, turning it to mid-on, no run again, the crowd egging their side on, tension gradually building
punches to cover, not taking any risk here, but Watson can suddenly explode and nobody will know what's hit them, he's been the player of the tournament so far
pushed to the on side, fine end to the over, another short-of-a-length ball
slow bouncer this time, 97kph, too far down the legside and Kaif just needs to duck under it
135.2kph, short of a length, tapped away to mid-on, another dot, the crowd is getting behind him here
pushed off the back foot, carefully done

yorker-length ball on the pads, turned away effortlessly and they scamper through for a couple, both are really quick, Kaif is speeding through here, send him to Beijing, I say. Chance for an athletics gold.
tapped to short third man and they hurry through for a single
139.2kph, straight and short of a length, defended confidently down the ground
tapped to point, some tight bowling here but Kolkata need wickets, if these two batsmen get set, expect the runs to flow, and there's Yusuf and Jadeja to come later
jumps on the back foot, typical Kaif shot, straight to the cover fielder, though
runs another one down to third man, easily done, he's getting into his groove here
short of a length, punched off the back foot to extra cover
good-length ball, glided to third man for a single, he's been in fine form in this tournament
pushed through cover, finds the gap and takes a single
short of a length, pushed to the on side, what an over, double-wicket maiden for Gul, now if only I had him in my fantasy league team

what a catch! Kolkata on a roll here, Gul has struck again, he's bowled one way down leg and Smith has tried to flick it past the keeper, a faint edge but Saha has dived full-length to his right to pluck off a sensational one-handed take, what a moment, take a bow Saha
short and wide but that's smashed straight to point again, can't find the gap
cracked to point but that's well fielded by Hussey

soft dismissal there, short of a length and Tanvir has holed out to mid-on, tried to go over the infield but can only manage a skier to mid-off, Butt is waiting there and it completes an all Pakistani dismissal ... Tanvir c Butt b Gul
short of a length and a bit wide, feeling for that there, misses it, that was a good ball
short of a length this time, angled to third man for a single
whoa! now that's a massive one, rocks back and pelts the short one way over square leg for a biggie, he's pulped that with all the might he can summon, what a shot
that's languid, stands and smashes one matter-of-factly through mid-on for four, that's as calm as it gets, what a shot
sensible stuff here, a tap and a run that follows a four, experience coming into play here
spanked that one, moved away outside off and ripped that through point for four, raced away, that's beefy
punched hard to cover, can't beat the field
tip and run there, these two batsmen seem to have a good understanding
tries to glide one past point again but can't beat the field
short of a length again, tapped calmly to the leg side and that's a risk-free single
another risky run and Hafeez misses a direct hit, turned to square leg and they take off but that was too reckless, a direct hit there and Smith was gone
full and angling away, pushed to cover
that's a fine shot, slightly outside off and Smith uses the pace of the ball to glide it expertly behind point for four, that's class
glided away to third man for a single
full and outside off, steered to point
short of a length, pushed to mid-on for a quick single
good-length ball outside off, pushed to the off side, they think of a single but decide against it
short of a length, tapped to gully and they take off, Hussey goes for the direct hit but Tanvir would have made it in time
left alone outside off

that's the breakthrough, swinging away from Asnodkar and he's thrown his bat at it wildly, tries to smash it through the covers but only manages an outside edge to the keeper, important wicket for Ishant, Asnodkar can be dangerous
that's Romesh Kaluwitharana at his best, Swapnil waits there and lashes that hard thorough the covers, not a man move, Eden stunned, what a creamer that was, the Goa Canon is on his way
full and outside off, Smith driving on the move, and they take off for a quick one, the mid-off fielder can't get a direct hit, that could have been very tight
pushed back to the bowler, watchfully done there, bit of uneven bounce here
on the pads and helped along easily, Smith just needs to tuck that away past fine leg for four, speeding away to the fence
138.1kph, slightly short of a length and Swapnil tries to whack that through square, under-edge falls towards point and they take off for a quick single
131.3kph, short of a length, defended watchfully to the off side
that's pummelled with minimum fuss, short and he's quick on the shot, waits for it and dismisses it through midwicket for four
short and wide, Smith cuts but the ball isn't coming onto the bat, bounces into the ground and straight to Hussey at point
short this time, outside off but there's some low bounce there, he tries to pull and can't gauge the bounce, goes under the bat through to the keeper
short of a length, tucked away efficiently to square leg for a couple
fine start, inswinging yorker straight away, 126kph, needed to dig that one out, speedy start
